title: Vern Pivot Cross Statistics — Globex VWAP
summary: Saved ES crossing results presented one question at a time, with a brief description, findings summary and chart or table. Actual eligible dates are January 3, 2020–September 18, 2026. Population, outcome horizon and missing support remain explicit. These descriptive observations do not establish profitability.

sections.title: Globex VWAP statistics
sections.body:
VWAP-only RTH and VWAP-only full-Globex populations are separate. RTH eligibility does not require a complete late-session Globex tail. No pivot is required; pivot-dependent questions are omitted.

Requested dates: 2020-01-01–2026-10-30. Actual valid coverage is recorded beside each saved measure. VWAP uses cumulative one-minute HLC3 × volume from 18:00 New York; EMA6 uses completed three-minute closes and the cloud uses completed five-minute closes.

Ranked questions appear below in the requested order. Priority forward views use actual EMA6 crossings; original price-cross outcomes remain in the accessible baseline and full private evidence. Whole-sample views preserve all horizons; conditional and calendar forward views emphasize 30 minutes. Public calendars select frequency, movement, recross and first timing measures, with all years and the latest 12 available months; every ranked measure retains full annual/monthly evidence privately.

The Actual valid date coverage column describes observations contributing to each measure. The Eligible cohort period coverage download separately records the eligible session count and actual window bounds, including sessions with zero crossings. Those cohort windows can extend beyond the valid-event coverage of a measure; empty periods have zero sessions and blank bounds.

Each findings summary describes an explicitly named saved baseline. Compact tables show its selected supporting rows. The earlier Ranked statistics reports retain the full saved views and filters. The companion notebook presents these same questions, prose, saved defaults and chart bytes.

sections.description: Count actual completed three-minute EMA6–VWAP transitions in two separate pivot-independent populations: full Globex and regular trading hours. Globex initializes at 18:00 New York; the VWAP reset itself is not a crossing.
sections.finding: The full-Globex mean was 10.78 crossings per session across 1,292 eligible sessions. The separate RTH mean was 2.89 across 1,308 sessions. Their observation windows and eligible populations differ; the chart preserves those identities.

sections.description: Measure directional price displacement from the observable EMA6–VWAP event close over a complete 30-minute RTH path. The full-Globex recurrence population is not used for overnight forward outcomes.
sections.finding: Across 3,551 complete RTH outcomes on 1,030 distinct days, mean 30-minute directional displacement was 0.02 ES points and 50.1% ended strictly positive. Another 232 candidate outcomes were unavailable; no trade fills or costs are modeled.

sections.description: Measure excursions and fixed point reaches after actual EMA6–VWAP crossings using complete 30-minute RTH paths. Favorable and adverse reaches can both occur, and the saved summaries do not infer intraminute order.
sections.finding: For 3,551 complete paths on 1,030 distinct days, mean favorable excursion was 8.72 ES points and mean adverse excursion was 8.35 points. The share reaching 10 favorable points was 31.0%. These are path measures rather than realized returns.

sections.description: Observe the next reverse EMA6–VWAP transition within a complete 30-minute RTH window. Require the entire window even when a reverse is already observed, and preserve late or missing windows as censored.
sections.finding: No reverse EMA6–VWAP cross occurred in 2,173 of 3,551 complete windows (61.2%), supported by 1,030 distinct days. Another 232 windows were censored; this describes line persistence rather than directional trading profit.

sections.title: Evidence qualifications
sections.body:
Repository-retained ES data only; requested coverage ends 2026-10-30, while retained market data ends 2026-09-18. Missing dates/contracts and retrospective full-day eligibility limit generalization.

Historical pivot available_at remains unverified. Nominal 09:25 timing does not establish a historically executable pre-open signal.

Returned-without-EMA and eventual confirmation labels are known later. Already-aligned EMA6 is distinct from an actual new line crossing.

Signed displacement and excursions describe price paths. No entries, fills, costs or net profitability are tested. Broad slices are exploratory.

This extends an already observed completed study and is not an untouched holdout. EMA–VWAP crossings use the moving difference, carry strict side through equality, clear unknown comparisons and exclude anchor initialization. EMA recrosses are separate from price reversals. Pivot retests remain fixed-pivot only. Five-observed-session moving-block intervals use 2,000 replicates, seed 20261031; within-day events remain together. Broad conditional slices are exploratory.

notes: Repository-retained ES data only; requested coverage ends 2026-10-30, while retained market data ends 2026-09-18. Missing dates/contracts and retrospective full-day eligibility limit generalization.
Historical pivot available_at remains unverified. Nominal 09:25 timing does not establish a historically executable pre-open signal.
Returned-without-EMA and eventual confirmation labels are known later. Already-aligned EMA6 is distinct from an actual new line crossing.
Signed displacement and excursions describe price paths. No entries, fills, costs or net profitability are tested. Broad slices are exploratory.
